facts.business: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited (CFHL) is a Core Investment Company and Middle Layer NBFC that primarily holds investments in its subsidiary, associate, and group entities, including Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited (43.76%), Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited (60.00%), and Cholamandalam MS Risk Services Limited (49.50%).
key_risks: Credit risk concentration in Vehicle Finance segment (53% of loan book)
Interest rate risk: 100 bps increase impacts PBT by Rs 133.43 crore (FY26)
GDP sensitivity: 5% decrease increases ECL by Rs 11.66 crore (FY26)
Foreign currency risk on borrowings (hedged 1:1 via cross-currency swaps)
Liquidity risk managed by ALCO monthly and sub-committee weekly
